title: What's New for members and candidates
summary: Admins, members, and candidates each now have their own What's New page so PRs can publish audience-specific release notes.
details: Members can view release notes via the member sidebar, and candidates can view release notes via the candidate sidebar. Each audience has its own curated JSON feed and API endpoint, protected by role-based authorization. PR authors can add tailored entries for any affected audience.

title: Admin-only ATS release notes page
summary: Admins can now view a curated, in-product history of ATS changes directly in the app.
details: The new page is reachable from the admin sidebar under "What's new." Entries are sorted newest-first and include release date, category, affected area, summary, and expandable detail text with optional related links. The content is maintained as a versioned JSON file so release history persists across recruiting cycles. Member and candidate accounts cannot access the page or its API.
